name: external-link
description: An arrow leaving a rounded open window toward the upper right.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Open window centerline bounds 7.5..16.5, radius 1.5. Upper arm stops at (10,7.5), right arm at (16.5,14), leaving clear space for a separate outbound arrow. Arrow runs (11.5,12.5) to (16.5,7.5); head arms are (13,7.5) to the tip to (16.5,11). Filled uses exact radius-.875 window expansion (corner radii 2.375/.625), and an analytically unioned shaft and solid triangular head rotated -45 degrees. The default visible bounds are 6.625..17.375, centered on both axes. Window-to-head gaps are 1.25px at Regular and .5px at Bold. Conservative Circle clearance exceeds .26px at Bold. All None/Square/Circle forms use the identical native glyph position and size, without per-frame transforms. Outline defaults to Regular 1.75 with round caps/joins, Thin 1.25 and Bold 2.50. Standard frame exteriors span 2..22, with Square radius 4 and Circle radius 10; Outline frame centerlines span 2.875..21.125 with corner radius 3.125 / Circle radius 9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone Filled silhouette as transparent negative space. Original project geometry; no third-party SVG paths used. All forms remain drafts pending owner review. CURRENT FRAME NONE ENLARGEMENT: the owner requested larger standalone icons while preserving the existing framed glyphs. The preceding shared None/frame size rule is superseded for this identity. Scale native Outline geometry uniformly about12,12 by 2.0277777778 but keep Regular1.75 and round-cap radius.875 fixed. Rebuild Filled from the enlarged centerlines with fixed.875 expansion; do not scale Filled thickness or apply an SVG transform. Visible Regular exterior bounds are2..22 on both axes, centered at12,12. Square/Circle source SVGs and metadata are intentionally unchanged and retain the earlier smaller native framed glyph. All revised standalone drawings remain drafts pending owner review. CURRENT NO-FRAME POLICY: the owner explicitly removed Square and Circle variants for this identity. Only Frame None is supported; prior notes about framed glyphs and frame clearance are historical. Preserve the enlarged standalone size and fixed Regular1.75 stroke. Window rounding is revised to exterior radius6 and Outline centerline radius5.125, with unchanged visible bounds2..22. Its three window corner centers are(8,8),(8,16),(16,16); upper endpoint is(8,2.875) and right endpoint is(21.125,16), at their tangent stations with round radius.875 caps. Filled uses exact analytical exterior radius6 / interior radius4.25; the diagonal arrow shaft and solid-head compound paths are byte-identical to the preceding implementation draft. No runtime transforms or stroke scaling are used.

review.note: Owner requested no frame variants and softer natural window corners. Standalone result awaits visual review.
